text.玄関の扉を開けると大谷石の壁が迎えるモダンな住まいは、ヴィンテージマンション、広: Open the front door and an Oya stone wall meets you: a modern home, renovated at Hiroo Garden Hills, a vintage block. Lime plaster and wool-linen carpet carry the scheme, with walnut panelling and Oya stone holding the attention on cool colour and texture. The living room, with two large works of art on the wall and Japanese furniture placed about it, takes in the greenery beyond the window and has something of the air of a hotel lounge. The bedroom walls are finished in a pale English paint, and with timber furniture of real texture arranged against the trees outside the window, it became an unhurried room like one in a summer retreat. The tiled bathroom pod, made to order, uses the same tile as the washroom, which holds the two together.
text.オーダーで作ったコの字型のセミオープンのキッチン。大きな配膳台は、ダイニングテー: A U-shaped semi-open kitchen, made to order. The large serving counter is sized so that it can also be used as a dining table.
text.寝室の壁と天井は、淡い色合いのイギリス製の水性塗料で仕上げました。ビニールクロス: The bedroom walls and ceiling are finished in a pale English water-based paint. Unlike vinyl wallcovering it takes lighting softly. It is free of the volatile organic compounds (VOCs) harmful to people, and at home it has been used in the restoration of castles. Natural pigments, no smell, a smooth finish.
